confidence_notes: Restaurant and drink anchors are rough, using mixed-date sources: Numbeo-derived aggregator tables, crowdsourced estimates, and undated hotel menus, several of which are from 2023 or earlier. Bar and wine prices are the least certain because hotel menus overstate typical independent-restaurant prices. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and the Jaipur tourism context, not from live listings. Wine was set relative to beer (roughly 2.5 to 3 times the beer anchor), and cocktails were anchored to the reported bar averages. The FX observation comes from RBA-domain search results and was not verified by opening the F11.1 table, so confirm it before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Indian tourist-city price levels, anchored to Jaipur-specific aggregator and menu figures for food and drink, and to general knowledge of Indian mid-size tourist cities (for example, Udaipur and Agra) for accommodation. No single comparable city was used.
